annotations.title: Search the parsed blocks of an extraction job's datasheet

description: Case-insensitive text search over the parsed blocks' text and table cells: each hit gives the block id, page, type, box and a snippet; a table hit also gives the cell's id, row, column and box. Scope it to a section (section_id, or heading_text) and to the job's target package; filter by pages and block types; paged (offset / next_offset, at most 100 hits). Unlike datasheetvend_search_document (raw text lines of the document map), hits here are typed blocks you can read whole with datasheetvend_read_document_block. Deterministic: reads the job's stored parse (parsed_document_v1), calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key; readable jobs are your own, your workspace's TEAM-shared jobs and PUBLIC jobs, as on the REST API. Refusals: NOT_PARSED / PARSE_FAILED (no usable parse stored for this job), PARSE_EXPIRED (past retention), DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE (over 20,000 blocks). Every block, cell and word comes with its page, box ([x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF points, origin top-left), quoted text and parse {document_sha256, parser_version, block_id, cell_id}; block ids are stable only within one parser_version.

heading_text.description: Only sections whose heading holds this text, and the sections below them (e.g. 'Pin Description').

job_id.description: An extraction job in your account (or shared with it).

limit.description: Hits to return. Default 20, at most 100.

offset.description: Skip this many hits (from next_offset). Default 0.

query.description: The text to find, 2-120 characters (e.g. 'VDD', 'Absolute Maximum').

section_id.description: Only this section and the sections below it.

target_package_only.description: Skip blocks printed for another package than the job's target part (the packets' own package scope). Default true; with no known target nothing is skipped and scope.package_scope says target_package_unknown.

name: datasheetvend_search_document_blocks
title: Search the parsed blocks of an extraction job's datasheet
